Calculate King County region

Source: R/calc-basic.R
calc_KingCo_region.Rd

Calculate King County region

Usage

calc_KingCo_region(
  df,
  region_var,
  zip_cd_var,
  county_name_var,
  state_cd_var,
  hml_var = NA_character_
)

Arguments

df

A data frame

region_var

quoted name of the output variable specifying region of King County

zip_cd_var

quoted name of the variable specifying zip code of residence; can be >5 digits but only the first five are used

county_name_var

quoted name of the variable specifying county of residence (e.g., 'King Co.')

state_cd_var

quoted name of the variable specifying the 2-letter code of the state of residence (e.g., 'WA')

hml_var

optional 0/1 indicator for whether the person was homeless/unstably housed (H/UH); if specified, H/UH appear in their own category

Value

Input data frame df with the addition of region_var
